info.name: PopArticle API
info.description:
Complete API collection for PopArticle - AI-Powered Content Platform

## Two Types of Users:

### 1. Platform Admins (tenant_id = NULL)
- Login/Register on your admin website WITHOUT X-Tenant-ID header
- Manage tenants and platform settings
- Use 'Authentication - Platform Admin' folder

### 2. Tenant Users (tenant_id = value)
- Login/Register on tenant websites WITH X-Tenant-ID header
- Belong to specific tenant, isolated data
- Use 'Authentication - Tenant User' folder
- Same email can register on multiple tenants as separate users

## Authentication Methods:
1. JWT Token Authentication (for web/mobile apps)
2. API Key Authentication (for programmatic access)
